title: Two hydrogen-burning engines powered this car to a new land speed record
summary: JCB decided to build an entirely new hydrogen engine , drawing on its experience developing diesel engines and sharing much of the engine architecture. Setting a world land speed record with hydrogen power, twenty years after Dieselmax, is a huge privilege.
